scenes.script:
SIENNA: "Dad. Dad, I am not taking a bodyguard..."  → xem 18 video bên dưới
(toàn văn mở đầu đã được chia thành shot)

scenes.name: Sân trước dinh thự — “Anh lái”
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "You're standing in front of my car."
COLT: "Yes, ma'am."
SIENNA: "I'm driving myself today."
COLT: "No, ma'am."
SIENNA: "I will put this car in drive."
COLT: "That's your right, ma'am. I'd just ask you to aim for my left side. The right knee's already bad."
SIENNA: "...Is something wrong with you?"
COLT: "Several things, ma'am. None of them contagious."
SIENNA: "Ugh. FINE. You drive. Under protest. I want that noted somewhere official."
COLT: "I'll file it, ma'am. Destination?"

scenes.name: Trong xe — “Anh là đồ đạc”
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "The Pemberton. And here's rule one: silence. Total silence. You are furniture."
COLT: "Copy that, Miss Whitlock."
SIENNA: "That was talking."
COLT: "You addressed me, ma'am. Furniture has to acknowledge orders. Otherwise how would you know it heard you?"
SIENNA: "Who told you that you were funny?"
COLT: "My mother."
SIENNA: "She lied to you."
COLT: "I'll pass that along."
SIENNA: "...Wait. What were you about to say just now?"
COLT: "Nothing, ma'am."
SIENNA: "You inhaled. People inhale before they talk."
COLT: "I was breathing, ma'am. It's involuntary."
SIENNA: "Well, stop it."
COLT: "The breathing?"
SIENNA: "The — you know what you're doing. Stop doing it."
COLT: "Yes, ma'am."

scenes.name: Boutique — “Cách hai bước”
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "Why are you two feet behind me? Everywhere I go. Two feet. Like a shadow with a haircut."
COLT: "Two feet is the coverage distance, ma'am."
SIENNA: "This is a boutique. The most dangerous thing in here is the price tag."
COLT: "Then it'll be an easy afternoon for both of us, ma'am."
SIENNA: "You know what, this is exactly why I never wanted a dog. I can't stand being followed."
COLT: "I'm not a dog, ma'am."
SIENNA: "No. A dog would be cuter."
COLT: "..."
SIENNA: "What."
COLT: "Nothing, ma'am. Just noting for the record that you called me the less cute option. Implying a scale. Implying I'm on it."
SIENNA: "That is NOT — Dad. DAD. Your soldier is twisting my words in a Chanel store."

scenes.name: Vỉa hè — Chìa khóa xe
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "Okay. Lunch, and then — where are my keys. Colt. WHERE ARE MY KEYS."
COLT: "Right here, ma'am."
SIENNA: "You pickpocketed me?"
COLT: "You handed them to me this morning, ma'am. In the driveway. You said, and I quote, 'Fine, you drive, I hope it rains on you.'"
SIENNA: "...That does sound like me."
COLT: "It sounded exactly like you, ma'am."
SIENNA: "Home. Now. This entire day is cancelled. You cancelled it. I hope you're proud."
COLT: "Deeply, ma'am."

scenes.name: Thư phòng — Grant tăng lương cho Colt
scenes.script:
GRANT: "How was day one, son? Be honest — I saw her face when she came in. It looked like a weather event."
COLT: "It was educational, sir."
GRANT: "Ha. Diplomatic. Listen — don't let the claws fool you. That girl used to volunteer at an animal shelter. Cried at commercials. Then her mother spent fourteen months in hospitals and didn't come home, and Sienna decided the safest thing a heart can do is bite first."
COLT: "She's not the hardest principal I've had, sir."
GRANT: "No? Who was?"
COLT: "A general's wife in Kandahar, sir. She threw a teapot at me."
GRANT: "Did Sienna throw anything?"
COLT: "Only words, sir. Her aim's better."
GRANT: "Ha! That's my girl. Listen. I'm raising your pay."
COLT: "Sir, that's not necessary—"
GRANT: "Your mother's insulin."
COLT: "...You looked into me, sir?"
GRANT: "I look into everything I care about, son. Four hundred and ninety dollars a month, and the pharmacy tells me she only picks up one vial when she's written for two. You think I don't know what that means?"
GRANT: "Whatever my daughter says to you, whatever she calls you — the fact that you're still standing there at the end of the day? That's why I picked you."

scenes.name: Quán bar — Dax cá cược
scenes.script:
DAX: "Say it again. Slower. I want to savor it."
COLT: "She said a dog would be cuter."
DAX: "The dog WON. Brother, this is the greatest thing that has ever happened to me and it isn't even happening to me."
COLT: "Glad my suffering nourishes you."
DAX: "It sustains me. Okay — I have a fix."
COLT: "No."
DAX: "You haven't heard it."
COLT: "Eleven years, Dax. I've heard it."
DAX: "Charm her."
COLT: "And there it is."
DAX: "You have it in you! Point that at the heiress. Mean girls melt. It's physics."
COLT: "Her father pays for my mother's insulin. I'm not flirting with that man's daughter. That's not a line, Dax, that's a canyon."
DAX: "Fine. Wager. Five hundred says she goes soft on you inside six months."
COLT: "You don't have five hundred."
DAX: "Details. OR — the premium bet — five hundred says YOU go soft on HER."
COLT: "On the woman who ranked me below a dog."
DAX: "Shake, coward."
COLT: "Easiest money I'll never see."

scenes.name: Nhà hàng — Colt đứng dưới mưa
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "Table's under Whitlock. Two hours, maybe three."
HOSTESS: "Of course, Miss Whitlock. And your — should I set a place at the bar for—"
SIENNA: "No. He waits with the car."
HOSTESS: "Ma'am, it's really coming down out there. We have a bench in the vestibule, it's no trouble at all—"
SIENNA: "He's on duty. Duty is outdoors."
—
BROOKE: "Sienna. Sienna, your guy is still out there."
SIENNA: "He's working."
BROOKE: "It's been two hours. He hasn't moved. Look at him, he's just — standing."
SIENNA: "That's the job. If he wanted to be dry he should have picked a different one."
BROOKE: "...That's a little cold, honey."
SIENNA: "He gets paid either way. Can we do the branzino for the table?"

scenes.name: Trong xe — Hạ cửa kính dưới mưa
scenes.script:
COLT: "Evening, ma'am. Door's open."
SIENNA: "God. What is that smell?"
COLT: "Ma'am?"
SIENNA: "In here. That — is that food? Are you eating in my car?"
COLT: "I ate before you came out, ma'am. My mother packs it. I'll air it out tonight."
SIENNA: "Roll the windows down."
COLT: "It's raining, ma'am."
SIENNA: "Then you'll get wet on both sides. Roll them down."
COLT: "...Yes, ma'am."

scenes.name: Trong xe — “Những cuộc đời nhỏ”
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "Colt. What is this."
COLT: "Ma'am, that's mine. It must have come out of my bag when I—"
SIENNA: "It's a bank statement. Seventy percent. You send seventy percent of every check to the same account."
COLT: "That's my mother's, ma'am."
SIENNA: "Seventy percent. And you live where — Eastbrook? Colt, can I be honest with you?"
COLT: "You usually do, ma'am."
SIENNA: "People aren't poor because of luck. They're poor because they choose small lives. Small choice, small choice, small choice, and then one day they look up and act shocked at where they are."
COLT: "Yes, ma'am."
SIENNA: "You're not going to argue with me?"
COLT: "Arguing isn't in the contract, ma'am."
SIENNA: "...That's not an answer."
COLT: "No, ma'am. It isn't."

scenes.name: Sảnh — Đôi giày dán keo
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "Stop. Turn around. Your shoes. Colt, is that GLUE? Is the toe of your shoe GLUED?"
COLT: "Yes, ma'am."
SIENNA: "There will be four hundred people at that gala and you are standing behind my chair. Here."
COLT: "...What's this, ma'am?"
SIENNA: "My father's old pair. Never worn. Take them."
COLT: "Respectfully — no, ma'am."
SIENNA: "Excuse me?"
COLT: "I'll polish mine. Nobody will be looking at my feet, ma'am. They'll be looking at you."
SIENNA: (laughing) "Oh my God. You're proud. That's the funniest thing about people like you — nothing in the bank, nothing in the closet, and the one thing you hold onto is the pride."
COLT: "Yes, ma'am."

scenes.name: Văn phòng Sienna — Preston & ly cà phê
scenes.script:
PRESTON: "AGH — my NOSE—"
COLT: "Door swings out, sir. There's a sign."
PRESTON: "Sienna, who IS this? Who hires a man who weaponizes doors?"
SIENNA: "He's the bodyguard my father won't let me return. Breathe through your mouth, you're fine."
PRESTON: "Your company, my family's distribution. Whitlock and Vale. The merger writes itself. We write ourselves."
SIENNA: "Preston, you just proposed to me with a supply chain."
PRESTON: "A beautiful supply chain."
SIENNA: "Get out of my office."
PRESTON: "...Is your soldier making a face at me?"
COLT: "This is my only face, sir."
—
COLT: "Ma'am. Coffee. Black, one sugar."
SIENNA: "...I'm sorry, is this a café? Did I miss a memo?"
PRESTON: "Unbelievable. We were in a private conversation—"
COLT: "And now you're in a coffee delivery, sir. Life moves fast."
PRESTON: "Are you MOCKING me? Is the help MOCKING me?"
COLT: "I'm not your help, sir."
—
SIENNA: "HEY! What is WRONG with you two?"
COLT: "For the record, ma'am — his fist, my face, his idea."
PRESTON: "He DUCKED."
COLT: "Yes, sir. That's the standard response to a fist."

scenes.name: Hành lang — Sienna sa thải Colt
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "Close the door. Give me one reason I shouldn't end this right now."
COLT: "He swung first, ma'am."
SIENNA: "Because you barged in with COFFEE. Why were you bringing me coffee in a closed-door meeting?"
COLT: "...Because you skipped breakfast again, ma'am. Third day this week."
SIENNA: "You're COUNTING?"
COLT: "It's hard not to notice things I look at all day, ma'am."
SIENNA: "That is the problem. You notice. You hover. Your job is a wall, Colt. Walls don't bring coffee."
COLT: "He isn't safe, ma'am."
SIENNA: "He's a Princeton man."
COLT: "In my experience those aren't opposites."
SIENNA: "That's it. You're done. You're fired."
COLT: "Ma'am — please. I need this job. My mother's insulin is four hundred and ninety dollars a month. She's already splitting the doses."
SIENNA: "I don't care. Three words. I. Don't. Care. Security will walk you out."
COLT: "...Understood, ma'am. It was an honor working for you."
SIENNA: "...Don't do that."
COLT: "Do what, ma'am?"
SIENNA: "That. Whatever that was. Just go."

scenes.name: Gala — Desmond & Ledger
scenes.script:
DESMOND: "Sienna! Forty years of Whitlock and my niece looks better than the champagne. Where's your father?"
SIENNA: "Working the room, Uncle Des."
DESMOND: "And your detail? Grant told me he'd put his best man on you."
SIENNA: "I let him go this afternoon."
DESMOND: "...Did you."
SIENNA: "Is that a problem?"
DESMOND: "No. Not a problem at all. Ledger's men have the floor covered."
—
COLT: "Badge, fob, garage card, vehicle keys. That's everything, sir."
LEDGER: "You could've mailed it, Bennett."
COLT: "Mr. Whitlock hired me face to face. He gets his property back the same way."
COLT: "...Voss. Your east stairwell door's chocked open."
LEDGER: "Catering."
COLT: "Catering finished at seven. And your man on the mezzanine walked off post four minutes ago."
LEDGER: "You don't work here anymore, Bennett."
COLT: "No, sir. Just telling you what I see."

scenes.name: Gala — Trần sập
scenes.script:
GRANT: "—and every jar, every tube, every ribbon of this company came out of one woman's kitchen table. Vivien Whitlock. My wife. Forty years ago tonight—"
SIENNA: "Dad? DAD—"
SIENNA: "Somebody help — SOMEBODY HELP HIM—"
COLT: "Ma'am. Ma'am, look at me. Can you walk?"
SIENNA: "Colt? My father — he's under the — he's not moving, he's not—"
COLT: "I've got him. I need you on your feet and behind me. Hand on my back and do not let go."
SIENNA: "He's not BREATHING—"
COLT: "He's breathing. It's shallow but it's there. Sienna. Look at me. I did this for six years in worse rooms than this."
—
COLT: "Kitchen's clear. Go through — mind the glass, keep your head down—"
SIENNA: "I'm sorry — Colt, I'm so sorry, I fired you, why are you even—"
COLT: "Not now."
SIENNA: "WHY ARE YOU HERE?"
COLT: "Because nobody else came. RUN."

scenes.name: Bệnh viện — Tước quyền
scenes.script:
DOCTOR: "Miss Whitlock. Your father is stable but he has not regained consciousness. There's swelling on the brain. It could be days. It could be longer."
SIENNA: "But he'll wake up."
DOCTOR: "...We're doing everything."
SIENNA: "That's not what I asked."
DOCTOR: "I know it isn't."
—
DESMOND: "Sweetheart. The board convened an hour ago. With Grant incapacitated, they've made me acting chairman."
SIENNA: "An hour ago? He's been in surgery for six."
DESMOND: "Markets don't wait, sweetheart. It's temporary."
SIENNA: "The east stairwell door was chocked open. Ledger's man walked off the mezzanine four minutes before—"
DESMOND: "Sienna. Listen to yourself. You've had a terrible shock. You're seeing patterns in smoke."
SIENNA: "I don't want Ledger driving me anywhere."
DESMOND: "...Of course. Get some rest, sweetheart. You look unwell."

scenes.name: Truyền hình — Desmond tuyên bố
scenes.script:
REPORTER: "—where acting chairman Desmond Whitlock addressed reporters this morning."
DESMOND: "My brother is fighting for his life. And I have to share something painful, as a family member. In the days since the attack, my niece has not been herself. Erratic behavior. Accusations against our own security staff. On the advice of counsel and with a heavy heart, the family has petitioned for an emergency conservatorship. Not to take anything from her. To protect her from herself. Sweetheart — if you're watching this — come home."

scenes.name: Ngân hàng & khách sạn — Mất tất cả
scenes.script:
TELLER: "Ma'am, I'm sorry, the card's been reported."
SIENNA: "Reported by WHO? It's my account."
TELLER: "It's flagged, ma'am. All three of them."
SIENNA: "I AM the account holder of record."
TELLER: "...The system says otherwise, ma'am. I'm sorry. I really am."
—
HOTEL CLERK: "Just a moment, ma'am, let me — one second—"
SIENNA: "It's a card key, the same card key I use every month, I keep a standing suite—"
HOTEL CLERK: (low, into phone) "Front desk. She's here. Yes. Standing at the counter right now."
SIENNA: "...Who are you calling?"
HOTEL CLERK: "Nobody, ma'am. Could you wait right here? Ma'am? MA'AM."

scenes.name: Bến xe buýt — Một đô bảy lăm
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "Excuse me. Ma'am, please — I need a dollar seventy-five for the bus. I'll pay you back, I can give you my earring, they're real—"
WOMAN: (im lặng)
SIENNA: "Ma'am? Please. I'm not — I'm not what you think I am."
—
COLT: "Sienna."
SIENNA: "...You said my name."
COLT: "Get in the car."
SIENNA: "How did you find me?"
COLT: "Your father's driver told me you left the hospital on foot. It took me nine hours. Sienna — where are your shoes?"
SIENNA: "They broke. On Ninth."
SIENNA: "Colt, I have earrings worth eleven thousand dollars and I do not have ONE DOLLAR."
COLT: "I know."
SIENNA: "I fired you. I said things to you I can hear right now in my own voice—"
COLT: "Sienna. Get in the car."
SIENNA: "...Where are we going?"
COLT: "Home. Mine."

scenes.name: Căn hộ 3B — Mama Ada
scenes.script:
MAMA ADA: "Colt Amara Bennett."
COLT: "Mama."
MAMA ADA: "Who is this."
COLT: "Mama, this is—"
MAMA ADA: "I know who it is. I have seen her face on my television for two days. I am asking why she is standing in my kitchen at four in the morning with no shoes."
COLT: "Because there's nowhere else, Mama."
SIENNA: "Mrs. Bennett — I'm so sorry. I shouldn't have come."
MAMA ADA: "Sit down."
SIENNA: "...Ma'am?"
MAMA ADA: "You are swaying. People who sway, sit. Are you the one who made him stand in the rain?"
SIENNA: "...Yes, ma'am."
MAMA ADA: "Two hours. And the food. My food. You made him open the windows in the rain because of my food."
SIENNA: "...Yes, ma'am. I did that."
MAMA ADA: "Hm. At least you did not lie about it. Liars I put out. Colt. Get the blanket from my room. The good one. She is grey as a fish. And you — eat this."
SIENNA: "...What is it?"
MAMA ADA: "It is the food you would not have in your car."
SIENNA: "...Oh."
MAMA ADA: "What."
SIENNA: "...It's very good, ma'am."
MAMA ADA: "Yes. I know. Eat it before you cry into it and ruin the salt."

scenes.name: Căn hộ 3B — Tuần đầu tiên
scenes.script:
COLT: "Couch is yours. There's one bedroom and my mother has it, that's not negotiable."
SIENNA: "Where do you sleep?"
COLT: "Kitchen floor."
SIENNA: "Colt—"
COLT: "It's a floor. I've slept on worse floors in worse countries. Bathroom's got hot water between six and eight in the morning and eight and ten at night."
SIENNA: "...That's a real thing? That's how it works?"
COLT: "That's how it works."
—
MRS. KAMINSKI: "Colt Bennett! Is that a woman in your apartment?"
COLT: "Cousin, Mrs. K. Visiting from out of town."
MRS. KAMINSKI: "You don't have cousins. You have a mother and a bad knee. She looks hungry. Bring her Thursday."
—
SIENNA: "Colt, the machine ate my quarters and it's making a noise—"
COLT: "That one's dead. There's a sock on it. That's what the sock MEANS, Sienna."
SIENNA: "WELL I DIDN'T KNOW THE SOCK."

scenes.name: Bếp 3B — Hóa đơn là ông chủ
scenes.script:
MAMA ADA: "Girl. Come here. You left the light on in the hall all night."
SIENNA: "I'm sorry, I—"
MAMA ADA: "Look. This paper on the refrigerator. What is it?"
SIENNA: "...The electric bill."
MAMA ADA: "Read the number."
SIENNA: "One hundred and forty-one dollars."
MAMA ADA: "Yes. In this house that paper is the boss. Not me. Not Colt. Not you. That paper. When you leave a light on, you are arguing with the boss, and the boss always wins. Now. You will hang the towels properly. Like THIS. Or they will smell and I will know who did it."
SIENNA: "...Yes, ma'am."

scenes.name: Route 12 — Đồng 25 xu
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "Colt. I need to get downtown. The courthouse posts the conservatorship filings—"
COLT: "I'm on a double. I can't drive you till nine tonight."
SIENNA: "Then I'll take a — oh."
COLT: "Bus. Route 12. Every twenty-two minutes. A dollar seventy-five."
SIENNA: "...I don't have—"
COLT: "I know. Here."
SIENNA: "What's this?"
COLT: "Dollar, two quarters. That's my lunch. Bring back the quarter."
SIENNA: "Colt, I can't take your—"
COLT: "Bring. Back. The quarter. That's the deal."
COLT: "Sienna. Sit near the driver. Head down. Don't talk to anybody. And if a camera turns your way, get off two stops early and walk."

scenes.name: Nhà thờ — Kho thực phẩm
scenes.script:
DEACON RAY: "Afternoon. First time?"
SIENNA: "...I'm not sure I'm supposed to—"
DEACON RAY: "Nobody's supposed to. Everybody's welcome. No forms, no questions, no ID."
SIENNA: "I don't have any way to prove that I need—"
DEACON RAY: "Did I ask you to prove anything?"
SIENNA: "...No."
DEACON RAY: "Then take a bag. Beans, rice, the bread's from Rosa's. And take the eggs."
SIENNA: "I don't want to take more than—"
DEACON RAY: "Everybody's too proud to take the eggs, and then Thursday comes and I throw eggs away. You'd be doing me the favor."
SIENNA: "...Why are you being kind to me?"
DEACON RAY: "You know how long it's been since somebody asked me that? Because it's Tuesday, and you're hungry, and I've got eggs. That's the whole reason, honey."

scenes.name: Cửa hàng Rosa — Trang chín
scenes.script:
ROSA: "You're the one staying with Ada."
SIENNA: "...How does everyone know that?"
ROSA: "Honey, this is three blocks. If you sneeze on Wexler Street, somebody says bless you on Palmer. Ada tell you about the book?"
SIENNA: "What book?"
ROSA: "TITO. Bring me the book. Every name in it owes me. Ada's on page four. Eleven years."
SIENNA: "...She owes you money?"
ROSA: "She owes me SOMETIMES. Then she pays, then she owes. That's not debt, mija, that's just how the month goes. You need bread?"
SIENNA: "I don't have—"
ROSA: "Did I ask you that? Tito, put her on page nine."
TITO: "Name?"
SIENNA: "...Sienna."
TITO: "Cool. You're page nine now. Congratulations, most people wait like a year. Hey, is your phone broken? I fix phones. Fourteen dollars."
SIENNA: "I don't have a phone anymore."
TITO: "...Everybody has a phone. Okay, that's actually kind of sad. Rosa, can she have a soda?"
ROSA: "Page nine, Tito. Put down the soda."
TITO: "PAGE NINE, SIENNA. It's basically a credit card."

scenes.name: Căn hộ 3B — Khâu vết thương
scenes.script:
COLT: "Don't make a thing out of it."
SIENNA: "There's blood on your shirt."
COLT: "It's the shoulder. It's old, from the gala."
SIENNA: "Sit DOWN, Colt. Where's your kit?"
COLT: "...Under the sink."
SIENNA: "Tell me what to do."
COLT: "You don't have to—"
SIENNA: "COLT. I have never in my life done one single useful thing with my hands. Tell me what to do."
COLT: "Gloves first. Now the brown bottle — pour it, don't dab it. Now the curved needle."
SIENNA: "My hands are shaking."
COLT: "That's fine. Mine shook for a year. Breathe out when you push. Not in. Out."
SIENNA: "Colt. Why did you come back? At the gala."
COLT: "Because I saw the stairwell door and I told Voss and Voss didn't care. And I sat in my car for eleven minutes arguing with myself. If I'd walked back in at minute one instead of minute eleven, your father—"
SIENNA: "STOP. You went in. Everyone else ran out, and you were the only human being moving the wrong way. Don't you dare put my father on your shoulders. He's on mine."

scenes.name: Bếp 3B — Lọ insulin
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "Mrs. Bennett? MAMA ADA—"
SIENNA: "COLT! SHE'S ON THE FLOOR — Tito! TITO, I NEED YOUR PHONE!"
COLT: "Sienna. Slow. Is she breathing?"
SIENNA: "Yes — she's clammy, she's grey—"
COLT: "Blood sugar. Fridge door, orange juice. Is she able to swallow?"
SIENNA: "I think — yes—"
COLT: "Then sit her up, support her head, small sips."
MAMA ADA: "...You are shouting in my house."
SIENNA: "Oh my GOD. Colt, she's talking—"
COLT: "I heard her. Twelve minutes out. Sienna — you did good."
—
COLT: "Mama. How many units this morning."
MAMA ADA: "Enough."
COLT: "How MANY."
MAMA ADA: "Twelve."
COLT: "You're written for twenty."
MAMA ADA: "And there are eleven days left in the month and one bottle in the door."
—
SIENNA: "Colt. What are these lines? There are marks on the bottle. Seven lines, in marker, by hand."
COLT: "She measures it out. Stretches a vial from four weeks to seven."
SIENNA: "Then why—"
COLT: "Because it's four hundred and ninety dollars a month, Sienna. That is what it costs."

scenes.name: Bếp 3B — Item 41
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "...What is this on the back. The small print. 'Distributed by Meridian Health Solutions.' Colt. Meridian is ours."
COLT: "What?"
SIENNA: "Meridian is a Whitlock company. It's four floors of an office building with my mother's name on the deed. I sat in a room. Six weeks ago. Item forty-one. Pricing adjustment, specialty pharmaceuticals. I raised my hand. It took nine minutes, Colt. There were pastries on the table."
COLT: "...Sienna."
SIENNA: "I need the bathroom—"
—
COLT: "Sienna. Open the door."
SIENNA: "She drew those lines with a marker at her kitchen table. Because of item forty-one. Because of me and a room full of pastries."
COLT: "It's a corporation. A hundred people and a spreadsheet, it isn't one person—"
SIENNA: "I RAISED MY HAND, COLT."

scenes.name: Sàn bếp — Lời xin lỗi lúc 2 giờ sáng
scenes.script:
COLT: "Two in the morning."
SIENNA: "I know."
COLT: "You're sitting on my bed."
SIENNA: "...It's a floor."
COLT: "It's my floor. Technically that makes it a bed."
SIENNA: "Colt. I want to say something and I need to say all of it, so please don't be kind to me in the middle."
COLT: "...Alright."
SIENNA: "I told you people are poor because they make small choices. In nineteen days I have watched you make about forty decisions before noon, every day. What she eats. What time you leave. Which shift so the pharmacy's open. Whether you eat — which you don't, most days."
COLT: "Sienna—"
SIENNA: "Not kind. You promised. Forty decisions, and not one of them is about you. That's not a small life. That's the biggest life I have ever stood next to, and I called it small. To your face. In your car. While you drove me."
SIENNA: "I'm not asking you to forgive it. I just needed it said out loud, in the room where it happened, by the person who did it."
COLT: "...Sienna."
SIENNA: "...You keep doing that. My name. I used to order you to stop calling me ma'am. Now you stop and I can't stand how much I like it."
COLT: "...I can go back to ma'am."
SIENNA: "Don't you dare."

scenes.name: Khu phố — Họ tìm ra cô
scenes.script:
TITO: "Rosa. ROSA. There's three black trucks on Palmer. They've got a picture. It's HER. It's page nine."
ROSA: "Get Ada's boy on the phone. Then get up on that roof and count them."
—
LEDGER: "Ma'am. Evening. We're looking for this woman. She may be in this building."
MRS. KAMINSKI: "Sweetheart, I've been the landlady of this building since Nixon resigned. This girl has never been in my building."
LEDGER: "You're certain?"
MRS. KAMINSKI: "I'm seventy-four. I'm certain about four things and this is one of them. Now move your foot, my program's on."
LEDGER: "Ma'am—"
MRS. KAMINSKI: "MY PROGRAM."
—
ROSA: "In the back. Behind the milk crates — Tito, STACK THEM."
SIENNA: "Rosa, if they find me here, they'll say you hid a fugitive—"
ROSA: "Down. Head down."
SIENNA: "Why are you doing this? You've known me nineteen days."
ROSA: "...Because Colt brought you."
SIENNA: "That's the whole reason?"
ROSA: "Mija, around here that IS the background check."

scenes.name: Khu phố — Chuông nhà thờ
scenes.script:
TITO: "They're going north. All three trucks. They think she's in a laundromat on Cutler."
COLT: "...You did what?"
TITO: "I fix phones, man. Fourteen dollars. This one's free, though. She's page nine."
—
COLT: "Deacon. I need thirty people on the street in ninety seconds and I don't have thirty people."
DEACON RAY: "...Son, I've got a bell."
—
LEDGER: "There's forty people on this street, sir. Fifty. They're just standing there looking at us."
DESMOND: "Then take her."
LEDGER: "In front of fifty witnesses?"
DESMOND: "...Fall back. FALL BACK."

scenes.name: Căn hộ — Tito phá khóa điện thoại
scenes.script:
TITO: "Okay so it's a burner. Bad news, no cloud, no backup. Good news, whoever set it up did the absolute minimum, which means the PIN is going to be something stupid."
COLT: "How long?"
TITO: "Four hours. Maybe five. Can somebody feed me? I'm twelve."
—
TITO: "Sienna. Come here. There's a message thread. From three weeks before that party."
SIENNA: "...Three weeks before?"
TITO: "Yeah. And, um. It's not about you."
SIENNA: (reading) "'East stairwell, nine o'clock, when he takes the podium.' 'The daughter's detail is being removed. She'll be in the room.'"
COLT: "...Sienna."
SIENNA: (reading) "'Confirm receipt. — D.W.'"
SIENNA: "He didn't just take the company after. He put my father under that ceiling. Three weeks before it happened, he wrote it down."

scenes.name: Phòng họp — Phiên xét
scenes.script:
DESMOND: "—this is the hardest thing I have ever done. I held her at her christening. So I'd ask the board to confirm the permanent conservatorship—"
BOARD MEMBER: "...Sir. The door."
SIENNA: "Don't stop, Uncle Des. You were being human about it."
DESMOND: "...Adelaide."
SIENNA: "Sienna."
DESMOND: "Look at yourself. LOOK at her — where did you even get those CLOTHES—"
SIENNA: "Rosa's cousin's church runs a clothing drive on Saturdays. The coat was twelve dollars, and Mrs. Kaminski said the color suits me. And these people behind me are the reason I'm alive. This is Colt Bennett, who my uncle removed from my detail eleven hours before somebody dropped a ceiling on my father. Adaeze Bennett, who fed me when I had nothing. Rosa Delgado. Deacon Raymond Hollis. Ida Kaminski. And Tito Delgado, who is twelve, and who did in four hours what a room full of lawyers didn't do in three weeks."
DESMOND: "This is a BOARD MEETING—"
SIENNA: "Sit down, Uncle Des. SIT DOWN."

scenes.name: Phòng họp — Bằng chứng
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "Put it on the screen, Tito. Read the date at the top out loud."
TITO: "...It says three weeks before the gala."
SIENNA: "And the last line."
TITO: "...'Confirm receipt. D.W.'"
BOARD MEMBER: "Desmond. What is this?"
DESMOND: "It's a fabrication. This girl has been living in a SLUM with—"
SIENNA: "Careful."
DESMOND: "—with people who would say anything for money—"
SIENNA: "They never asked me for a dollar, Uncle Des. Not one. In twenty-three days, in the poorest three blocks in this city, not one person asked me for anything."
—
DETECTIVE: "Desmond Whitlock. Ledger Voss. Preston Vale. Hands where I can see them."
PRESTON: "Sienna — I didn't know about the gala, I SWEAR, I only moved the money—"
SIENNA: "You only moved the money."
PRESTON: "I love you, Sienna—"
SIENNA: "Goodbye, Preston."

scenes.name: Phòng họp — Item forty-one
scenes.script:
SIENNA: "No. Sit down. There's a second item and I've been carrying it for two weeks. Item forty-one. Six weeks ago, in this room, at that seat, I voted to raise the price on specialty pharmaceuticals. It took nine minutes. Half of you were on your phones. I know because I was on mine."
BOARD MEMBER: "It was a routine adjustment—"
SIENNA: (đặt lọ thuốc lên bàn) "Look at that. It's insulin. Look at the lines on the side. Somebody drew those with a marker on her kitchen table so she could stretch four weeks into seven. Her name is Adaeze Bennett and she is sitting in the third chair on your left, and nineteen days ago I found her on a kitchen floor."
SIENNA: "We're rolling item forty-one back. Today. Retroactive. And we're building a patient assistance program on top of it."
BOARD MEMBER: "That's a nine-figure hit to the quarter."
SIENNA: "Then let it cost us the quarter. My mother built this company at a kitchen table. Somebody at another kitchen table is drawing lines on a bottle because of a vote I raised my hand for. All in favor."

scenes.name: Bệnh viện — Cha tỉnh lại
scenes.script:
NURSE: "Miss Whitlock! He's asking for you."
SIENNA: "...He's what?"
NURSE: "He opened his eyes and the first thing out of his mouth was your name."
—
GRANT: "...Sweetheart."
SIENNA: "Hi, Dad. Hi."
GRANT: "...You look terrible. What are you WEARING?"
SIENNA: "It's twelve dollars and I'm never giving it up."
GRANT: "...Des. Where's Des—"
SIENNA: "Dad. It was Uncle Desmond. He's in custody."
GRANT: "...My brother."
GRANT: "...Then who — twenty-three days, who took care of you?"
SIENNA: "Dad, I want you to meet some people. This is Rosa, Deacon Ray, Mrs. Kaminski. That's Tito, he's twelve, he broke the case. That's Mrs. Bennett, who fed me and made me hang towels properly."
GRANT: "...And him."
COLT: "Sir."
GRANT: "Son, where was my daughter for twenty-three days?"
COLT: "...On my couch, sir. My mother made her hang towels properly."
GRANT: "Colt Bennett, I am going to give you something and you are going to take it."
COLT: "Sir, respectfully, no."
GRANT: "I haven't said what it is."
COLT: "Doesn't matter, sir."
GRANT: "...(to Sienna) Is he always like this?"
SIENNA: "Always."
GRANT: "How does anybody thank him?"
SIENNA: "You don't, Dad. That's the whole thing about him."

scenes.name: Đồng 25 xu
scenes.script:
COLT: "You never gave it back, by the way. The quarter. Route 12."
SIENNA: "...You are seriously bringing up a quarter to a woman who just rolled back a nine-figure pricing structure."
COLT: "A deal's a deal, Sienna."
SIENNA: "...I'll pay you back."
COLT: "No, you won't. Because if you pay it back, we're even, and if we're even I don't have a reason to keep showing up."
COLT: "...That came out worse than it sounded in the truck."
SIENNA: "Colt. Come here."
—
COLT: "Sienna. Wait. I have to say the whole thing or I'll lose my nerve. I have a one-bedroom apartment where the hot water runs on a schedule. A mother who counts units in the morning. A knee that tells me when it's going to rain and a paramedic certificate I've deferred three times. That's everything I own."
SIENNA: "Colt—"
COLT: "And you have a company and a name on forty-one buildings. Different planets, Sienna. I know the math."
SIENNA: "...You want to hear my inventory? Nineteen days ago I had a name and three frozen accounts and not one single person in this world I could call at four in the morning. And a man whose life I set on fire drove nine hours to find me barefoot at a bus stop and said 'get in the car.' So don't talk to me about planets. There's the couch, and the floor, and a kitchen at two in the morning, and that is the only real address I have ever had."
SIENNA: "Also I'm keeping the quarter. Forever. It's mine."
COLT: "...That's theft."
SIENNA: "Sue me. I know a good firm."

scenes.name: Một năm sau
scenes.script:
MAMA ADA: "—and I said to the reporter, do not put my face on the poster. Put the bottle on the poster. They put my face on the poster."
ROSA: "It's a good poster, Ada."
MAMA ADA: "It is an ENORMOUS poster. It is on the SIDE OF A BUS."
DEACON RAY: "Bennett Access Fund, statewide. Forty-one thousand people last quarter."
MAMA ADA: "I told the girl to eat. Everything after that, she did herself."
—
SIENNA: "Colt. You're going to be late for your own first day."
COLT: "I'm not late."
SIENNA: "It's a four-year program, you've deferred it three times, and if you defer it again I'm having you removed from my property."
COLT: "...You're driving me?"
SIENNA: "I'm driving you."
COLT: "Nothing. It's just — passenger seat. Eighteen months I never once sat in the passenger seat."
SIENNA: "Get in the car, Bennett."
COLT: "...Yes, ma'am."
SIENNA: "Oh, don't you DARE."

scenes.name: Một năm sau — Tito & Deacon
scenes.script:
TITO: "Sienna! Look look look. It's a WORKBENCH. It's got a soldering station AND a light AND a little drawer thing for the tiny screws. Rosa says it's from the scholarship people."
SIENNA: "Huh. Imagine that."
TITO: "It wasn't you, right? Because if it was you I'd have to be weird about it."
SIENNA: "It wasn't me, Tito."
TITO: "...Okay good. Thanks though."
—
DEACON RAY: "Thursday."
SIENNA: "Thursday."
DEACON RAY: "You know you don't have to keep coming, honey. You could write a check and never smell a cardboard box again."
SIENNA: "I know."
DEACON RAY: "...Take the eggs."
SIENNA: "I always take the eggs, Deacon."

scenes.name: Sân trong — Đám cưới
scenes.script:
MRS. KAMINSKI: "—by the power vested in me by the internet, which took forty minutes and eleven dollars, I now pronounce you husband and wife. Kiss her, Colt Bennett, my soup is getting cold."
—
DAX: "Five hundred dollars."
COLT: "Not tonight, Dax."
DAX: "FIVE HUNDRED DOLLARS, BROTHER. And I want it in small bills, and I want you to hand it to me during the slideshow."
COLT: "There's a slideshow?"
DAX: "There has ALWAYS been a slideshow. Slide one is a photograph of your face on the day she called you less cute than a dog. Slide two—"
COLT: "Dax."
DAX: "Slide two is the SAME PHOTOGRAPH but I've circled it."
—
GRANT: "Look at her. Twelve-dollar coat. Three pools at home and she got married in a courtyard between two fire escapes."
MAMA ADA: "It is a good courtyard."
GRANT: "...It's the best courtyard I've ever been in, ma'am. Thank you for feeding my daughter."
MAMA ADA: "She was grey as a fish."
GRANT: "I've been told."
MAMA ADA: "Also she left the hall light on all night."
GRANT: "...Yes. She does do that."
MAMA ADA: "Not anymore."
—
COLT: "Hey. You alright?"
SIENNA: "I keep waiting to feel like I'm visiting. Twenty-three days here and a year of Thursdays and it still hasn't happened. Colt, I think this is the only place I've ever been where nobody wanted anything from me."
COLT: "Rosa wants forty dollars."
SIENNA: "Rosa can wait. I'm page nine, I'm in excellent standing."
COLT: "(raising a plastic cup) To the quarter."
SIENNA: "To the quarter."
